question: Do complete qualitative candle body/wick configurations predict the immediately subsequent Bitcoin bar direction beyond unconditional frequency and lag-one direction autocorrelation?
window: Contiguous candles t,t-1,...,t-n+1, ordered current-first; all endpoint relations retained.
feature_scope: Only candle body and wick endpoints, plus optional body direction. Volume and all other source columns are excluded from features.
time_policy: UTC candle opening timestamps; features available at t+interval; target available at t+2*interval. Current and target candles must be in the same split. No boundary-crossing training labels.
missing_policy: Retain real source rows; reject duplicate, unordered or off-grid timestamps; skip every feature window and target crossing a missing grid bar. Never forward-fill or compress gaps.
flat_policy: Keep down/flat/up counts for every pattern and split. Exclude exactly flat targets from binary probability scores and report their counts.
unobserved_policy: Represent the complement of all observed canonical patterns with its exact arbitrary-precision size and zero empirical observations. Predict the fitted unconditional probability for an unseen pattern; no pattern-specific evidence is claimed.

analysis.selection: Choose alpha per n/mode on validation log loss; choose one n/mode/alpha per timeframe and target on validation log loss, with deterministic ties. Refit chosen counts on train plus validation, then freeze for the entire test.
analysis.comparison_timeline: Use the common valid n=10 decision timestamps within each timeframe for every candidate's validation and test scores. Keep all eligible training observations per geometry. Fit shared baseline and unconditional-prior probabilities from every eligible n=2 fitting observation.
analysis.primary_comparator: learned_lag1_close_direction for cc; learned_current_body_direction for secondary body target
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across the five validation-selected primary cc tests. All-candidate test tables are descriptive. Secondary body tests are a separate exploratory family.
analysis.interpretation: Retrospective classification experiment. Test is held out from this experiment's fitting and selection; some historical data were examined in earlier Filang work. No profitability inference from direction accuracy.
